title: Personal Loans Credit Policy Schedule: Grade Entry Requirements
content:
Larkspur Lending prices Personal Loans in seven rate grades, Personal Loan Grade A through Personal Loan Grade G. Each grade sets the credit profile an applicant must show at application. The schedule below states every grade's requirements.

## Requirements by grade

| | Grade A | Grade B | Grade C | Grade D | Grade E | Grade F | Grade G |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Minimum credit score (FICO Score 8) | 760 | 720 | 690 | 665 | 645 | 625 | 600 |
| Maximum debt-to-income ratio, percent | 35 | 40 | 40 | 45 | 45 | 50 | 50 |
| Minimum verified gross annual income, USD | 45000 | 40000 | 35000 | 30000 | 27500 | 25000 | 22000 |
| Minimum credit history, whole years | 5 | 4 | 3 | 3 | 2 | 2 | 2 |
| Maximum hard inquiries in the 6 months before application | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 |

## What each figure measures

- **Minimum credit score**: minimum FICO Score 8 at application for this grade (integer).
- **Maximum debt-to-income ratio**: maximum debt-to-income ratio after the new payment, percent of verified gross monthly income (mortgage/rent included).
- **Minimum annual income**: minimum verified gross annual income, USD.
- **Minimum credit history**: minimum age of oldest tradeline on the credit report, whole years.
- **Maximum recent inquiries**: maximum hard credit inquiries in the 6 months before application (integer).

A minimum is met by a figure equal to it or above it; a maximum is met by a figure equal to it or below it.

## Reading the schedule (hypothetical profile)

A hypothetical applicant shows a score of 700, a debt-to-income ratio of 42 percent, verified income of 50000 USD, a 6-year oldest tradeline and 2 recent inquiries. Against each Personal Loans grade:

| Grade | Score | Ratio | Income | History | Inquiries |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | below 760 | above 35 | met | met | met |
| B | below 720 | above 40 | met | met | met |
| C | met | above 40 | met | met | met |
| D, E, F, G | met | met | met | met | met |

The profile meets every requirement of Grades D, E, F and G, and misses at least one requirement of Grades A, B and C.
